extracted.name: Ranch Water
extracted.description: Visit Texas in the summer, and you'll find people drinking ranch water at every bar and restaurant you go to. This simple cocktail is bubbly and refreshing. With just 3 ingredients, it's easy to make at home. Learn how with this recipe!
ingredient_lines: Topo Chico (chilled, to top (about 4 to 6 ounces))
instruction_lines: Fill a rocks glass with ice. Add the tequila and lime juice and stir.
Top with the Topo Chico and garnish with a lime wedge.
